title: consult
description: A diagnosis of one rejected round. The orchestrator answers exactly this and nothing else.

diagnosis.description: model-error: an ideal implementation COULD satisfy every failing criterion, and the code is wrong. criterion-unsatisfiable: at least one failing criterion cannot be satisfied by any correct implementation, so the round was never about the model. unclear: you cannot tell from the evidence. Choose unclear rather than guessing; it costs one round and a wrong model-error costs the tree.

reason.description: Why, in a few sentences, citing the specific failing command and what its output shows. A reason that does not name a command is not a diagnosis.

narrowed_instruction.description: Only when diagnosis is model-error. A narrower instruction for the SAME plan and the SAME criteria: name the exact file, method and behaviour to fix. You may not restate, weaken, reinterpret or add a criterion. Null otherwise.

unsatisfiable_commands.description: Only when diagnosis is criterion-unsatisfiable. The exact command lines that cannot be satisfied, copied verbatim from the plan.
